about: Golden vectors for the album About core (com.gpo.yoin.shared.albumabout, Android PR #326): the prompts, the reply parser, the stored credits format, the stored rows as the page reads them, the credits line with its line-break segments, Apple Music's editorial notes and the AI service's name in copy. Generated from :shared Kotlin through YoinAlbumAbout by AlbumAboutGoldenTest (androidHostTest); do not edit by hand. Every vector is its inputs followed by the answer. Strings are UTF-16 (Kotlin / Swift String.utf16 / Dart); in creditsLine.text, \u00a0 is a no-break space and \u2060 a word joiner. Dates are ISO at the service's precision; creditsLine.dateText is the service-dated first release as the platform's own date format writes it in that language (Android ICU yMMMMd / yMMMM).
